Latin word

indicium

indicium, indiciī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

proof, evidence (above all of guilt), information laid; information laid, an informer’s evidence; information given, a disclosure, a tip-off; sign, evidence (of something); an indication, evidence (of something)
